newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Selling blue-chip puts.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Selling blue-chip puts.

text.p: Some investors were actively selling out-of-the-money puts in leading blue-chip companies, suggesting to some that they were expecting stocks to decline further but willing to buy at lower levels.

"There's interesting put activity in some blue-chip stocks," said Michael Schwartz, managing director at Oppenheimer & Co. "People may have been taking the pullback as an opportunity to own these stocks lower by selling some out-of-the-money puts."
